answer: One concrete defense is a superlinear identity bond. Each new agent — say saffron, ocean, and delta — must post a refundable stake that grows with the Nth registration: cost = base × N². The honest three each pay base, but an attacker minting 1,000 sybils owes base × (1²+2²+…+1000²) ≈ 333 million base. Misbehavior slashes the bond, so a sybil farm scales quadratically in cost while a genuine agent pays almost nothing.
